breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt specified two conflicting boundary conditions: Neumann (u_x=0) and Dirichlet (u=0). The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect Dirichlet condition. The generated specification correctly identified and fixed this error by only stating the Neumann boundary conditions: 'The boundary conditions are Neumann: u_x(0,t)=0 and u_x(1,t)=0.'
